label: Dei Filius 'vivus' at the spine's root from pure act through LIVING_2 and a restricted sense bridge
summary: Stage two of the modal spine, the Dei Filius living conjunct (follow-up to attempt b93ce632, PR #1474). Before: the root endpoint NecessaryDeiFiliusGodRootAt (c0f4a346) got its LIVING_1 conjunct (timeless primitive Primitives.Lives) only through the open bridge 'Whatever HAS_INTELLECT_1 is LIVING_1' (8d2ac441). Done (specs/dei-filius-living-self-operation.toml, TruthCore/Causality/DeiFiliusLivingSelfOperation.lean, zero axioms): deiFiliusRootLivingFromPureAct, a second verified route to c0f4a346 that composes the registered deiFiliusRoot without its living bridge (applied to primitives whose Lives is HasIntellect, so that bridge holds trivially and nothing about the real Lives is used) and takes the root's pure act from its immutable conjunct (IsImmutable InPotency has the body PureAct InPotency). The existing STMT-PURE-ACT-LIVES (derived in result PURE-ACT-LIVES-FROM-SELF-OPERATION from PureActOperates, SelfOperatingUnmovedLives and MovedOnlyAsInPotencyReading, all open) gives the root life at some time of the duration frame (LIVING_2); the new open sense bridge ad49ea00 'Whatever is in POTENCY_1 in no respect and is LIVING_2 is LIVING_1' gives LIVING_1. The same composition at an arbitrary being with the nine (nineGiveDeiFiliusLivingFromPureAct, result 08bf7a13) gives a second verified bundle for the restated sufficiency premise 5fbea2f5, whose immutability conjunct is pure act; that is the route on which the living bridge reaches STMT-CATHOLICISM-TRUE in the computed frontier (the root endpoint c0f4a346 has no computed path to the root). SENSE HANDLING: LIVING_1 and LIVING_2 (disambiguation 1f2d3b9b) are not identified; the passage is one listed sense_bridges premise, restricted to pure act. Motivation, not derivation: the open premise STMT-LIFE-BOUNDARY-REQUIRES-POTENCY (812b52b3: whatever begins or ceases to live is in potency in itself; q.10 a.1 co. supports only the weaker 'is not altogether immutable', and q.9 a.1 does not cover beginning or ceasing to live, since creation is not properly a change) would make a pure act's life at some time not a temporary episode. That motivates only some time -> every time of the frame; every time -> timeless LIVING_1 (sempiternal versus eternal, #979) rests on the bridge alone. LivesSomeTime is a reducible definition, so LIVING_2 differs from a raw existential over LivesAt only nominally; STMT-PURE-ACT-LIVES does not yet link disambiguation 1f2d3b9b or definition 885a98f3 (deferred to #216); for beings in potency the passage can fail (a being that lived once), which is why the unrestricted LifeAtSomeTimeIsLiving is recorded only for comparison. The frozen DeiFiliusAttributes structure and its Challenges are unchanged; the living conjunct is still LIVING_1, now with a second sufficient condition. CONTROLS (result 2de8c08d, sense_mixing_control): nonvacuity; a pure act that is LIVING_2 and not LIVING_1 (STMT-PURE-ACT-LIVES alone does not give the conjunct); the bridge alone gives a pure act no LIVING_1 (no omission model for the full premise bundle of either composition is checked); the restricted bridge holds where the unrestricted one fails; the new premises hold while the intellect bridge fails (the route does not presuppose it). PREMISE COMPARISON on these routes (computed frontier-diff: one verified support alternative added for 5fbea2f5; open premises reaching the root 441 -> 442, the new bare sense bridge): each removes 8d2ac441 (bare); adds ad49ea00 (bare, new) and STMT-PURE-ACT-LIVES (already a root-reaching premise of the eternity routes, with one verified derivation from three open premises). So no reduction in open-premise count; the change is formal: living follows from the derived pure act rather than from the intellect conjunct, and the sense passage is explicit. The independence from 8d2ac441 is formal only (control part 5): q.18 a.3 grounds God's life in his being his own understanding, and STMT-PURE-ACT-OPERATES generalizes from God to every pure act, so the source warrant still runs through intellect. The old route stays registered. OBJECTION AUDIT (substantive objection standard): main warrant gap: the generalization in STMT-PURE-ACT-OPERATES from God (his own understanding, q.18 a.3 ad 2) to every pure act. One scope point on the universal STMT-PURE-ACT-OPERATES (target: 'whatever is in potency in no respect operates from itself'; mechanism: an immutable, causally inert being with no potency and no operation, such as an abstract object if the Being domain contains one and InPotency is unactualized ability; justification: the usual platonist characterization of abstracta as causally inert, no source on file). A concrete-restricted premise would suffice only for the root endpoint route (a159ecaf -> c0f4a346), whose witness is actual and concrete; that endpoint has no computed root path. The root-reaching route (08bf7a13 -> 5fbea2f5) quantifies over any being with the nine, with no concreteness, so there the premise would have to be restricted to beings with the nine or to beings with intellect; an intellect restriction would make the route lean on intellect again and reduce its claimed independence from 8d2ac441. Unread lead on the other side: Plotinus (the One as source of life rather than living, Enn. VI.7) would target 'the first lives' only through a sense bridge like the one recorded for intellect (DISAMB-PLOTINIAN-PRIORITY-UNITY); not read, not an objection. No substantive objection identified to SelfOperatingUnmovedLives or to the new sense bridge. WARRANT AUDIT: no claim states the sense bridge, STMT-PURE-ACT-LIVES, PureActOperates or SelfOperatingUnmovedLives; q.18 a.3 (claim 611be1f0) supports the latter three by relations whose notes record the generalization from God to every pure act. MovedOnlyAsInPotencyReading is the Prima Via premise with its own record. Unread supporting lead: Aristotle, Met. XII.7 1072b26-30 (life belongs to the god, since the actuality of thought is life). No premise is established.
blocker: Not blocked. Next tests: a concrete-restricted STMT-PURE-ACT-OPERATES if the abstracta scope point becomes the selected question; a typed account of LIVING_1 (operating from oneself without succession) under which the sense bridge could be derived or fail; derive life at every time of the frame from typed Boethian eternity (STMT-IMMUTABLE-IS-BOETHIAN-ETERNAL) and test whether that strengthens the motivation of the bridge; read Plotinus Enn. VI.7 and Met. XII.7 only if the warrant of 'the first lives' becomes the selected question.
